title: Q-YEAR-mail-relay-token: measure the mail relay token lifetime
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `mail-relay-token` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe mail-relay-token
**Status:** closed

Probe the relay daily with a no-send health call, record the answer, and add a second sign-in path that needs no relay token.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 23.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
